description: Returns one public water system's full record in the MORVS PFAS Drinking-Water Register by PWSID: each sampling location (a hashed key) with its sample events, first and last dates and complete-set averages in ppt, per-chemical sample and detection counts with the highest single result, the Hazard Index, the six derived flags, the six 2024 rule records with each one's status history and whether this system's averages meet its comparison cutoff, the source file hashes and the register's caveats. Raw samples are not published. UCMR 5 results are entry-point monitoring, not compliance determinations or household tap results, and EPA's May 2026 rescission and deadline documents are proposals. A system whose name the register withholds is shown by PWSID and city.

pwsid.description: EPA public water system ID, 9 characters, e.g. IA9778054.

name: pfas_system_history
title: Get PFAS Register System Record
